name: The main MCU
tagline: Where the Avengers live, and where the Time Heist happened.
designationSource: Doctor Strange in the Multiverse of Madness

facts.text: The Avengers reversed the Snap by taking the Infinity Stones from the past in the Time Heist.
Earth now has two teams claiming the Avengers name: Sam Wilson's, and Valentina's New Avengers.
facts.citation: Captain America: Brave New World; Thunderbolts*

facts.text: Doom tells the heroes they have "lived stolen lives" and must give them back.
facts.citation: Avengers: Doomsday final trailer, quoted by The Hollywood Reporter (23 Nov 2026)

unknowns: Whether Steve Rogers' life with Peggy happened in Earth-616's past or in a branch timeline

name: The Fantastic Four's world
tagline: A retro-futurist Earth with its own First Family.

facts.text: Home of Reed, Sue, Johnny, Ben and their son Franklin, who drew Galactus to their Earth.
A figure holding Doom's mask is seen with Franklin years later.
facts.citation: The Fantastic Four: First Steps — post-credits scene

facts.text: A ship matching the Fantastic Four's enters Earth-616 from another dimension.
The Fantastic Four use time travel to reach Steve Rogers and bring him back to fight Doom.
facts.citation: Avengers: Doomsday final trailer, as reported by Variety (23 Nov 2026)

unknowns: Whether Doom is native to Earth-828

name: The Fox X-Men universe
tagline: The world of the 2000s X-Men films, now in Doom's path.
designationSource: Deadpool & Wolverine (2024): the TVA names Deadpool's universe Earth-10005

facts.text: Deadpool's universe is Earth-10005. Its anchor being, that universe's Logan, has died.
Marvel says actors from the 2000s X-Men films reprise their roles in Doomsday.
facts.citation: marvel.com, "Everything to Know About Avengers: Doomsday" (5 Nov 2026)

facts.text: The Doomsday X-Men come from Earth-10005.
facts.citation: Fox-era actors reprising their roles; Endgame Encore TVA scene as reported by TheWrap
facts.note: Marvel has not stated the X-Men's Earth number.

facts.text: A TVA scene shows Earth-10005 on a collision course with Earth-1127.
facts.citation: Avengers Endgame: Encore (2026), as reported by TheWrap and others
facts.note: Reported from the re-release. An editor still needs to verify it against the footage.

unknowns: Whether Deadpool or Wolverine appear: neither is in Marvel's official cast list

name: The Illuminati's world
tagline: Visited in Multiverse of Madness. Not named as a Doomsday universe.
designationSource: Doctor Strange in the Multiverse of Madness (2022)

facts.text: Its Illuminati included a Charles Xavier played by Patrick Stewart and a Reed Richards played by John Krasinski. Wanda killed both.
facts.citation: Doctor Strange in the Multiverse of Madness

facts.text: Marvel describes Doomsday's heroes as coming from three universes. Earth-838 is not presented as one of them.

name: Unidentified
tagline: Reportedly shown colliding with Earth-10005. Nothing else is known.
designationSource: Avengers Endgame: Encore TVA scene, as reported by the press

facts.text: Reportedly appears on a TVA display, on a collision course with Earth-10005.
facts.citation: Avengers Endgame: Encore, as reported by TheWrap and Reactor
facts.note: Reports differ. Its identity is unknown.

unknowns: Whether the designation was reported correctly
